bones: As rifle-motion-ue5-v1: every clip keys the rotation of all 90 bones (real glTF locals) and the translation of root, pelvis and the IK bones; twist bones keyed with their shares.
clipSpace: Each clip is authored in its vehicle root's own glTF frame (vehicle_root / helicopter_root: +Y up, forward -Z, right +X, metres). notes `root` per frame [x, z, yaw]: where the character stands or sits on that frame's ground plane: root world (in the vehicle) = T(x, 0, z) * Ry(yaw); the character faces (sin yaw, 0, cos yaw), so yaw = pi faces the vehicle's forward. The root BONE keys the same track (rifle packs' rule: a player that places the character by notes `root` holds the root bone at rest). Height comes from the pelvis.
seatedReference: car-drive frame 0 and heli-fly frame 0 are the seated reference poses (each loop's life is added on top and is exactly zero at frame 0). The one-pose clips (car-steer-l/-r, car-look-back, heli-cyclic-*, heli-collective-*, heli-pedal-*) are whole-body poses built on that reference with only the control (and what follows it) changed: blend them ADDITIVELY over the loop, per bone delta = pose * reference^-1 (rotation; translation difference for pelvis), weighted by the control's share of its extreme (e.g. wheel angle / 90 deg), so the loop keeps the body alive; between two opposite extremes use one at a time by sign. Hands and feet: pin them with IK to the clip's `contacts` on the live node every frame, which makes the blend exact at the hands.

car.door: door_L: local rotation = rest * Rx(-55 deg * door), door 0 shut .. 1 open (the GLB's doors_open)
car.wheel: steering_wheel: local rotation = rest * Ry(wheel deg), glTF local +Y = the column towards the driver (the spec's Blender "local Z"); + = turned left. car-steer-l = +90, car-steer-r = -90; car-drive moves it +-3.7 deg (notes `wheel` per frame)

heli.door: cockpit_door_R: local rotation = rest * Ry(+68 deg * door)
heli.cyclic: cyclic: local rotation = rest * Rx(-fwd) * Rz(-right) about its floor pivot; heli-cyclic-f/-b fwd = +9.0 / -6.0 deg, -l/-r right = -/+6.0 deg
heli.collective: collective: local rotation = rest * Rx(coll) (+ raises the grip); heli-collective-down / -up coll = 4.0 / +20.0 deg, heli-fly holds 13.0
heli.pedals: pedal_L / pedal_R: translated along the parent's -Z by +-push; heli-pedal-l pushes the left pedal 0.045 m forward and the right one back by the same, -r the reverse

controls.note: Per clip, notes `ctl` holds the controls per frame (only those that move). The game's own control ranges may differ: scale the pose clips' weights to them; the contacts follow the nodes either way.

events: seconds from the clip's start: doorOpenStart, doorOpenEnd, seated, doorCloseStart, doorCloseEnd, handsOn (exit clips: doorOpenStart / -End, unseated (the hips leave the seat), doorCloseStart / -End, handsOff).
door: per frame 0 shut .. 1 open: the game drives the real door node from it (see controls).
contacts: list of {part: hand_l | hand_r | foot_l | foot_r, from, to (frames, inclusive), node (vehicle node name, or null = the ground / the vehicle root's frame), at: [x, y, z] in that node's own glTF frame (the palm's middle for a hand, the ball of the foot (point: ball) or the back of the heel (point: heel) for a foot), kind}. Pin the part to that point with IK while the node moves (the door handle rises with the door, the rim turns with the wheel, the grips move with the sticks). kinds: grip (closed hand round a rim / stick / handle), handle, push (flat hand), rest (hand or foot resting on a surface), press (foot on a pedal), step (foot taking weight), ground.
gun: Gun keys the rifle's sling place (rifle-motion's stow, chest frame) in every clip: no gun in the hands. The game puts the held gun on the back with the outgoing half of the swap clip before car-enter / heli-enter and hides both guns once the door is shut (VEHICLE_NOTES.md).

seat_driver.why: legs 0.78 m: seat slid fully forward on its rails (0.20 m) and down (0.03 m)

steering_wheel.why: wheel telescoped 0.03 m towards the driver along its column

pedal_L.why: legs 0.78 m: pedal adjuster at its aft limit, 0.25 m

pedal_R.why: legs 0.78 m: pedal adjuster at its aft limit, 0.25 m

pilot_seat.why: seat 0.145 m forward: the backrest against the back as the hands hold the controls (pass A3); 0.060 m down: its thighs off the cushion's front (pass A3 round 2)

vehicleFitNote: Fixed adjustments of the vehicle for this body family (a driver / pilot setting the seat, the wheel, the pedals): translate = an offset in the node's PARENT frame (here the vehicle root), added to its rest translation; the clips (root, contacts, poses) are authored with them applied: the game must apply the same offsets to the real model (a helper point moves with its seat).
